notes: scRGB: the ramp row is bit-identical between Independent Flip and Composed (0 differing pixels).
HDR10 Independent Flip: 49 two-code jumps, quasi-periodic (~16 codes apart) across the whole range -> suggests a piecewise-linear LUT in the scanout path.

HDR10 Composed: the periodic mid-tone jumps disappear entirely; instead 23 near-black codes (all <= 144) are skipped - consistent with DWM converting the PQ swapchain into its FP16 linear canvas and the output stage re-encoding to PQ (same exit as scRGB).
Focus alone does not demote the fullscreen window to composition (verified: focus on another screen's window, still Independent Flip); occlusion by a window on the same screen does.
